messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Surdoc Social Club?
messages.body:
Hi,

Just gently following up my note on Jake Essex for Surdoc Social Club.

Jake is from £300 for two one hour sets, or £250 a night when you book four. Three 45 minute sets are £350, or £300 a night for four. He brings his own PA and there's no deposit.

Dates are going quickly at the moment because clubs are block booking him. A few free Saturdays:
Saturday 2 January 2027
Saturday 6 March 2027
Saturday 27 March 2027
Saturday 10 April 2027
Saturday 5 June 2027
Saturday 11 September 2027

He also does a great Christmas show. Saturday 11 December 2027 is still free if you'd like him for next Christmas.

Just reply with the date that suits and I'll get it pencilled in.

Natalie
